browser_observations: Live board pages contain 25 and four of 29 cards.
Sprint selection retains the two assigned cards and goal.
An external successful outcome updates the card to Done and releases its dependent card.
Expanded history retains all 20 events after an external note.
Changing the source file updates the open Done card to Review, preserves recorded Done and gives the changed-source reason.
Restoring the source returns the card to Done.
The card exposes the full scope, legacy exception and links to decision records.
unmeasured: Daily human reminders and correction rate
limitations: The prototype source was not committed separately; its private logs record the measured run, but that exact interim source is not a reproducible release.
The final run uses the same repair, prompt and four facts; the dependent release claim was reclassified from code to writing.
The final regression suite also covers a subsequent fix that prevents an earlier decision outcome from attaching to its revised decision.
Actual Codex runs disable unrelated connectors and global memory. Full input still exceeds 10K.
No long-term autonomous scheduler or automatic lesson acceptance is added.
